pipeline.title: Ascletis’ challenger to Lilly’s Foundayo hits goals in phase 2 diabetes trial
pipeline.summary: A phase 2 trial of Ascletis’ oral GLP-1 drug candidate has hit its primary and secondary endpoints, positioning the Chinese biotech to mount a two-front attack on Eli Lilly’s Foundayo.

pipeline.title: Geron’s Rytelo stumbles in phase 3 as Novartis gears up for post-JAK inhibitor blood cancer bid
pipeline.summary: Geron has discontinued a phase 3 trial of its Rytelo in JAK inhibitor-pretreated myelofibrosis after an independent data monitoring committee ruled that the study was unlikely to succeed, just as Novartis is gearing up for a delayed FDA approval bid for its pelabresib.

pipeline.title: Genmab's $8B Merus bet delivers as bispecific combo halves risk of death in phase 3
pipeline.summary: Capping off a busy few days in Spain, Genmab reported results from the first interim analysis of a phase 3 trial showing that adding its bispecific antibody petosemtamab to Merck & Co.'s Keytruda cut the risk of death by 50% compared with Keytruda alone in patients with PD-L1

pipeline.title: Biogen CEO tells analysts he’s focused on early-stage R&D as ‘we were not very good with that’
pipeline.summary: Biogen's CEO has pointed to the company's ability to take five drugs into clinical trials so far this year as evidence of its new focus on early-stage R&D.

pipeline.title: Lilly’s retatrutide bests Ozempic on blood sugar, weight loss in phase 3 diabetes showdown
pipeline.summary: Eli Lilly’s triple-G drug candidate retatrutide has beaten Novo’s Ozempic in a head-to-head phase 3 trial, driving deeper reductions in blood sugar and body weight across the 80-week study.

pipeline.title: Vanda eyes GLP-1 nausea indication with Nereus phase 3 win in hand
pipeline.summary: Vanda Pharmaceuticals secured a phase 3 win for its motion sickness medicine, Nereus. The drug reduced GLP-1 related vomiting by 27% for patients on Wegovy.

pipeline.title: Novartis CEO unfazed by high-profile clinical failures, maintains long-term revenue goal
pipeline.summary: Two late-stage clinical failures of high-value projects have not changed Vas Narasimhan’s projection for Novartis over the next 10 years. Based on early launch trajectory in chronic hives and a positive phase 3 readout in relapsing multiple sclerosis, Novartis has increased its p

pipeline.title: Pfizer heads to FDA with phase 3 myeloma win for Elrexfio
pipeline.summary: Pfizer touted another Elrexfio phase 3 win in earlier-line relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma. Next up, the drugmaker is taking the data to global regulators in hopes of a label expansion.

pipeline.title: From RAS rivalries to leaked cancer vaccine readouts, ESMO brought the data drama
pipeline.summary: Every ESMO conference is eventful, but the drama kicked into gear earlier than expected this year when the eagerly anticipated phase 3 data for Moderna and Merck & Co.’s cancer vaccine were leaked two days before the Presidential Symposium.

pipeline.title: Novartis CEO keeps faith in Avidity deal despite taking $1.9B hit from del-desiran fail
pipeline.summary: Novartis CEO Vas Narasimhan has insisted that the phase 3 fail for del-desiran is just a “bump” in the Swiss pharma’s wider plans for the drug, despite costing the company an estimated $1.9 billion.

pipeline.title: GSK’s B7-H3 ADC drives 67% cancer risk reduction in Hansoh's phase 3 China trial
pipeline.summary: A phase 3 trial has linked GSK’s risvutatug rezetecan to a 67% reduction in the risk of disease progression or death, providing evidence that B7-H3-directed antibody-drug conjugates work in relapsed osteosarcoma.

pipeline.title: Boehringer, Microsoft team up to explore digital patient twins for clinical trials
pipeline.summary: Boehringer Ingelheim and Microsoft have launched a collaboration to explore the use of AI-powered digital patient twins to improve clinical trial design.

pipeline.title: Novartis' Rhapsido touts solid efficacy with industry-best safety data in RMS phase 3 reveal
pipeline.summary: In new data from Novartis' Remodel-1 and Remodel-2, Rhapsido's safety profile helped compensate for its solid but lower-than-expected efficacy data in RMS.

pipeline.title: BioNTech sees ‘limited’ benefit to ADC after phase 3 reveals modest efficacy, ILD cases
pipeline.summary: BioNTech has reported modest efficacy and unexpected safety findings in a phase 3 breast cancer trial, leading the company to conclude its HER2-directed candidate may offer limited benefits in the current treatment landscape.

pipeline.title: ESMO: In sac-TMT’s first global phase 3 win, Merck sees ‘pretty consistent’ data with China
pipeline.summary: As a cornerstone of Merck’s post-Keytruda oncology strategy, sac-TMT has cleared a clinical milestone. In its first global phase 3 win, the TROP2 ADC delivered results that are “pretty consistent” with earlier China data, according to Merck’s head of oncology clinical development

pipeline.title: ESMO: Why Incyte sees itself ‘neck and neck’ with RevMed in KRAS G12D pancreatic cancer race
pipeline.summary: Incyte has pointed to a spread of phase 1 data for its KRAS G12D inhibitor as evidence that the company has a worthy rival to Revolution Medicines in this increasingly competitive cancer space.

pipeline.title: Kennedy's HHS relaxes enforcement on 6 popular wellness peptides
pipeline.summary: Stopping short of a formal declaration allowing their use, Department of Health and Human Services secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. has cleared the way for the compounding of six popular wellness peptides.

pipeline.title: Flagship blends three biotech startups to form Etcelera
pipeline.summary: Etiome, Cellarity and Empress Therapeutics are being combined into one new AI-aided drugmaker claiming to possess the ability to better predict the way new medicines will fare in humans.

pipeline.title: FDA’s rare disease framework aims to ‘stand the test of time’
pipeline.summary: During a public hearing Wednesday to discuss a newly proposed rare disease framework, FDA center director Michael Davis, M.D., Ph.D., said the agency aims to design a scheme that “stands the test of time.”

pipeline.title: 'Numbers speak for themselves': Biogen's Apellis buyout fuels best quarter since 2020
pipeline.summary: Biogen CEO Chris Viehbacher said, "We're dramatically changing Biogen" on third quarter earnings call where the biotech announced revenue increase 11% year-over-yera.

pipeline.title: Lilly’s ‘triple-G’ drug tops Novo’s Ozempic in diabetes trial
pipeline.summary: The highest dose of retatrutide beat Ozempic on measures of blood sugar and weight loss, but was also associated with higher side effect rates and treatment discontinuations.

pipeline.title: FDA unveils guidance for ‘plug and play’ gene therapies
pipeline.summary: The plan builds on recent FDA moves to speed "personalized" treatments by offering an approval framework for therapies benefiting different subsets of patients with the same disease.

pipeline.title: After GSK's Q3 approval spate, Hibsago preps for 'concentrated' US hep B launch
pipeline.summary: Armed with a trio of recent high-profile approvals, GSK is banking on its specialty medicines to drive its next wave of growth, even as investor enthusiasm cooled Wednesday morning amid reports of restructuring charges and a vaccine sales dip at the British drugmaker.

pipeline.title: GSK vows not to ‘park crap on Page 41’ in transparency push
pipeline.summary: GSK CEO Luke Miels has committed to a transparent communication strategy, telling analysts that “we are not going to park crap on Page 41 of a press release and hope none of you notice it.”

pipeline.title: Blue Matter ‘turbocharges’ global reach of comms agency Cognite with acquisition
pipeline.summary: The deal stands to "turbocharge" Cognite's global reach and growth opportunities, chief business officer Sean Cush pointed out.

pipeline.title: Lilly combines global markets under new leadership role as 36-year veteran retires
pipeline.summary: Eli Lilly is consolidating its U.S. and international commercial divisions into a unified department, tapping current U.S. head Ilya Yuffa in a newly created role as president of Lilly Global Markets.

pipeline.title: Lilly shuffles business structure; Novartis writes off part of Avidity deal
pipeline.summary: Lilly intends to merge its U.S. and international divisions when a top executive retires. Elsewhere, Astellas closed in on what it believes to be a “best-in-class” cancer immunotherapy prospect.

pipeline.title: Amgen hit with FDA warning letter for ‘misleading’ Vectibix promotion
pipeline.summary: Amgen has been handed an FDA warning letter over a video promoting its cancer drug Vectibix, but the company said that the issues stemmed from an “inadvertent” submission and was not made available publicly.

pipeline.title: GSK predicts ‘some limited impact’ to UK roles as restructuring rolls on
pipeline.summary: GSK’s global restructuring plan is likely to see “some limited impact” to roles on the Big Pharma’s home turf of the U.K., executives have confirmed.

pipeline.title: Astellas makes $1.3B bet on Audax’s preclinical push to reverse decades of IL-12 woes
pipeline.summary: Astellas has struck a deal for Audax Biosciences’ IL-12 program, committing up to $285 million in upfront and option fees to secure a chance to license the preclinical immuno-oncology program.

pipeline.title: Eli Lilly surges up diabetes reputation rankings to close in on Novo
pipeline.summary: Eli Lilly has jumped up a ranking of the corporate reputations of diabetes drugmakers, putting it hot on the heels of Novo.

pipeline.title: Ferring to acquire next-gen IVF startup Gameto for up to $1.4B
pipeline.summary: The buyout hands Ferring rights to a technology capable of simplifying the lengthy and burdensome process of in vitro fertilization.

pipeline.title: Supernus shreds ADHD stigma with Olympic snowboarder Chloe Kim
pipeline.summary: The Olympic athlete and Qelbree user is the new face of Supernus' "Ms. Represented" campaign as it looks to reach a younger audience with its ADHD awareness messaging.

pipeline.title: ‘The patient need is enormous’: Syntax programs stem cells into pancreatic beta cells in 4 days
pipeline.summary: Chicago-based Syntax Bio believes it has cracked the code for turning stem cells into pancreatic beta cells in as little as four days.

pipeline.title: Teva telegraphs 61 job cuts amid plans to close 'underutilized' New Jersey plant
pipeline.summary: Amid Teva’s return to sales growth, the innovative-generic drugs hybrid has been taking steps to cut costs in parallel, with the downsizing push now reaching a U.S. manufacturing facility in the Garden State.

pipeline.title: Court rejects Novo bid to block Lilly obesity drug ads
pipeline.summary: Novo failed to prove that Lilly’s campaign — which featured claims of obesity drug superiority — meaningfully harmed the Danish company’s sales, a federal judge ruled.

pipeline.title: Artiva to quit autoimmune cell therapy work, cut staff after patient deaths
pipeline.summary: The disclosure makes Artiva the third company to recently report fatal events in an autoimmune cell therapy trial, following announcements from Novartis and Bristol Myers Squibb.

pipeline.title: WuXi AppTec bucks DOD uncertainty through Q3, lifting forecast for 2026
pipeline.summary: As it continues to confront a potential existential threat in the United States, CRDMO juggernaut WuXi AppTec’s finances certainly don’t seem to be feeling the pressure.

pipeline.title: Eli Lilly fends off Novo’s legal bid to block GLP-1 marketing claims
pipeline.summary: A U.S. judge has ruled Eli Lilly can keep making marketing claims challenged by Novo pending a ruling on a court case brought by the Danish drugmaker.

pipeline.title: Regeneron lands $270M in renewed US supply pact for approved Ebola med Inmazeb
pipeline.summary: As the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record continues to grip the Democratic Republic of Congo, the United States is taking renewed steps to protect its own citizens from the devastating virus.

pipeline.title: Artiva lays off 94% of staff after deaths and durability sink autoimmune cell therapy
pipeline.summary: Artiva Biotherapeutics has halted development of an autoimmune disease cell therapy and laid off 94% of its staff after two patients died and durability data fell short of expectations.

pipeline.title: Sun locks in first DTC spot for alopecia areata med Leqselvi
pipeline.summary: The new 60-second spot follows Sun’s fashion-forward “Regrowth Restyled” campaign and aims to spark awareness and hope for people living with alopecia areata.

pipeline.title: Parkinson’s-focused Aspen and bispecific biotech Bambusa both shoot for $134M IPOs
pipeline.summary: Parkinson’s disease cell therapy-focused Aspen Neuroscience and bispecific biotech Bambusa Therapeutics are each hoping to raise around $134 million from their respective IPOs.

pipeline.title: UCB’s Bimzelx leads pharma’s Q3 drug ad spend, but who will take the annual prize?
pipeline.summary: We’re heading into the final quarter of the year, and things are heating up in the drug ad spending space.

pipeline.title: Labcorp continues acquisition spree as it buys up Millennium Health
pipeline.summary: Labcorp is acquiring Millennium Health to boost the medtech giant’s toxicology testing capabilities throughout the U.S.

pipeline.title: Corxel claims oral obesity drug is in the ‘right lane’ as biotech plans SPAC route to Nasdaq
pipeline.summary: Corxel Pharmaceuticals may not have always planned to dust off the SPAC route to the public markets, but the obesity-focused biotech is happy with its choice.

pipeline.title: Pfizer’s Talzenna combo moves up treatment line with new FDA nod in prostate cancer
pipeline.summary: Pfizer’s Talzenna is now the first PARP inhibitor approved by the FDA to treat men with metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer.

pipeline.title: Corxel, an obesity drugmaker, to go public via SPAC deal
pipeline.summary: Armed with a $300 million financing and two GLP-1 and amylin-targeting medicines, Corxel is set to become the latest weight loss-focused company to join the public markets.

pipeline.title: BMS joins 3-year partnership to boost participation in cancer trials
pipeline.summary: The Institute for Healthcare Improvement has partnered with Bristol Myers Squibb on an initiative to expand access to cancer trials.

pipeline.title: BioNTech, DualityBio say ADC had ‘modest’ benefit in breast cancer study
pipeline.summary: The companies said the findings suggest the treatment has a “limited” impact in HER2-low breast cancer, an area where AstraZeneca and Daiichi Sankyo’s Enhertu has already set a high bar.

pipeline.title: ESMO ‘26: A cancer vaccine debate, Roche’s KRAS progress and Amgen’s ‘unprecedented’ data
pipeline.summary: At one of the year’s premiere meetings for cancer research, melanoma vaccine data hailed by scientists sparked a share sell-off on Wall Street, while a lung drug received a standing ovation.

pipeline.title: Anthropic lays out drug R&D ambitions, risks in mammoth IPO filing
pipeline.summary: Artificial intelligence giant Anthropic is pushing deeper into drug discovery, building its own molecular biology lab and investing in research that could eventually produce drug candidates, according to the company's blockbuster IPO filing.

pipeline.title: Lycia leaps onto Nasdaq with upsized $318M IPO as Windward breezes toward listing
pipeline.summary: Lycia Therapeutics went public with an upsized $317.5 million IPO on Friday, while immunology-focused Windward Bio is hoping to catch the same tailwinds.

pipeline.title: BMS sheds light on patient death in CAR-T trial, wants to get program back on track
pipeline.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb has shared more details with Fierce about the death of a patient who received the pharma's investigational CAR-T in a multiple sclerosis trial.

pipeline.title: Eversana combines forces with UK-based AI health economics research firm Estima in acquisition
pipeline.summary: Estima's AI and automation capabilities for health economics and outcomes research will help Eversana further leverage the "technology-first solutions" infused into its platform.

pipeline.title: Why researchers may have found the biological culprit behind Angelman syndrome
pipeline.summary: Scientists have known for a while that Angelman syndrome is caused by the loss of a specific gene, but they didn't understand how this gene loss leads to the failure of brain development in infants with the disease.

pipeline.title: Biopharma Companies Must Break the DMTA Linearity
pipeline.summary: Reimagining DMTA as a connected network gives scientists the flexibility to act when needed, with context retained across every decision

pipeline.title: The 2026 Biotech Graveyard
pipeline.summary: Fierce’s biotech graveyard is an annual tradition in which we remember all the companies we lost over the past year. While we're embracing the spooky spirit of Halloween, we hope the sad stories of drug developers shutting up shop won’t haunt the industry for too long.
